name: Swimmer Admiration
source:
Ishihara Kasumi's a Japanese student attending as a freshman at an Australian college. She's wanted to study in this college ever since she heard that her favorite swimmer, Zoe Kaplan, is also studying there. Dying to join the swimming club, she manages to pass the selection test and can't wait to train with her idol. However, Kasumi soon finds out that all that glitters is not gold.

[From [url=https://pushpublication.itch.io/swimmer-admiration]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
日本学生Ishihara Kasumi刚进入澳大利亚一所大学读大一。自从听说最喜欢的游泳选手佐伊·卡普兰也在这里就读，她便一直想来这所大学。她一心想加入游泳社，终于通过了选拔，迫不及待地想与偶像一起训练。然而，Kasumi很快就发现，并非所有闪闪发光的东西都是金子。

[摘自[url=https://pushpublication.itch.io/swimmer-admiration]itch.io[/url]]
